provider: Indiana DNR/USGS 3DEP 2018 LiDAR; COPC mirror hosted by iDiF at Purdue
crop: Purdue GIS FID237 polygon plus 12 m buffer; COPC returns and classifications retained
transform: GIS EPSG:4326 polygon transformed with pyproj to EPSG:2968; z retained in source vertical datum

statistics.method: Class 1 returns inside GIS ring eroded by 3 m; class 2 ground returns in a 5 m outer ring. Subtract nearby ground median from class-1 percentiles. Class 1 is unclassified and may include roof, canopy or other surfaces; this distribution is not a measured roof plane/eave/ridge.

uncertainty: No class-6 building returns may be available; unclassified returns can include trees and roof equipment. Mapping bounds are not a survey. 2018 predates any later repair.
